purpose: Acquire daily prices from 2011-01-01 for the survivorship-safe 2012-2026 issuer universe, so that every signal this project has tested on a 143-week bull sample can be retested across 2015-16, 2018, 2020 and 2022.

scale_reality.note: The earlier seven-day estimate covered the current 3,253-issuer panel only. Including the 8,830 issuers that exited before the panel begins is what makes the sample survivorship-safe, and it is four times the work. The queue is therefore tiered so that a usable panel exists after a few days and improves monotonically.

declared_before_running.history_start_rationale: One year of warmup before the 2012q1 fundamentals so that trailing-year signals are defined at the first decision date.

priority_tiers.name: current_panel_continuity
priority_tiers.rule: Issuers already in the current price panel, which extend an existing series backwards rather than starting a new one.
priority_tiers.why_first: Cheapest coverage gain per request and immediately usable, but on its own it is survivorship-biased and must never be researched alone.

priority_tiers.name: exited_long_lived
priority_tiers.rule: Issuers absent from the current panel that filed in at least 12 quarters.
priority_tiers.why_second: This is the survivorship correction. A long filing history means a real operating company rather than a shell, and Hou, Xue and Zhang show anomaly evidence is dominated by microcaps, so filtering toward substance is a research choice made before results exist.

priority_tiers.name: exited_short_lived
priority_tiers.rule: Everything else with a resolved ticker.
priority_tiers.why_third: Completes the universe. Expected to contain most of the shells, reverse mergers and never-traded registrants.

declared_before_running.ticker_change_policy: Where an issuer resolved to more than one ticker, request each ticker over the filed-date span in which it was observed, rather than assuming the latest ticker covers the whole history.
declared_before_running.identity_gate: Every response is checked with the existing issuer_name_match gate against the SEC name as filed. A name mismatch is recorded as a rejected row, never silently accepted, because recycled tickers are the main failure mode here.
declared_before_running.resumability: Every issuer writes a terminal result.json before the next is attempted. Restarting the daemon skips terminal rows, so an interrupted run loses at most one issuer.

not_claimed: No strategy may be evaluated on a partial backfill. The membership spine must be complete for a tier before that tier is researched.
Acquiring a price series does not establish that the issuer was investable, liquid, or borrowable.
Delisting returns are not solved by this program and remain an open gap.
